findings.message: Sub-process "Review items" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to catch unhandled errors thrown inside the sub-process.

findings.message: User task "Assess claim" has no timer boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add a timer boundary to enforce an SLA and prevent tasks from waiting indefinitely.

findings.message: "Check for fraud" (serviceTask) has no zeebe:taskDefinition type.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.
